description: Introduction of a Digital Card System for the supply of fuel to Vehicles belonging to Government Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The necessity to use a digital card system for supplying fuel to vehicles belonging to Government institutions has been identified. This will enable to top up through the online banking system according to the fuel requirement, and procure fuel with high transparency and efficiency by minimizing personnel intervention. The Bank of Ceylon and the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation have jointly introduced the system for supplying fuel to vehicles through digital cards by now. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the said system for supplying fuel to pool vehicles of the Presidential Secretariat as a pilot project, in the first instance and based on its success, to implement the same system for other Government institutions as well, was approved by the Cabinet.
